tasks.short: Check applicants against agreed vacancy requirements and pass suitable candidates to the recruiter or hiring manager.

today.trigger: A new application arrives in Recruitee or a recruiter requests an initial eligibility check.
steps: Read the vacancy requirements and candidate application.
Check stated experience, required certificates and availability for the site's shifts.
Record missing information and ask the candidate to clarify it.
Summarize the application and refer it to the recruiter or hiring manager.
drudgery: Repeatedly finding the same facts in differently formatted CVs.
Copying application details into referral notes.
Chasing missing availability or certificate information.
today.time_sinks: Reading inconsistent applications and writing summaries; this assumed workflow needs validation with the administrators.

lenses.faster: Extract explicit application facts into a requirements checklist with links to the source. The administrator checks gaps instead of repeatedly reading the whole CV.
lenses.autonomous: Each application triggers a draft checklist and referral summary. Missing or uncertain facts go into a review queue; the system does not reject or rank candidates.
lenses.ambitious: Give every applicant a consistent, documented first review, including applications received during seasonal peaks. Track whether the requirements actually predict productivity and retention at day 90.
lenses.joy: Remove copying and repetitive reading. Keep candidate conversations and the judgment needed to recognize transferable experience.
lenses.options: Show the evidence for each requirement and possible clarification questions. Offer different referral summaries for warehouse, transport and office vacancies.
lenses.altitude: The administrator maintains clear requirements and checks extraction quality, fairness and exception rates.
reach: Prepare recruiters' application briefings.
Maintain vacancy eligibility checklists with hiring managers.
Support People Analytics with screening-quality audits.

tasks.human_edge: A person recognizes transferable skills, handles unclear evidence and owns decisions affecting access to employment.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: an llm_step extracts unstructured application facts, but a person verifies the evidence and approves every referral or rejection.

in_practice.trigger: A new application enters an agreed Recruitee pipeline stage.
steps: Retrieve the approved vacancy checklist and application using restricted access.
Extract only explicit job-relevant facts, attaching source passages and marking uncertainty.
Prepare a checklist, missing-information questions and a referral summary without scoring candidates.
Have the administrator verify the evidence and record the referral decision.
Update Recruitee after approval and route rejection decisions to the recruiter.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator approves each referral; an authorized recruiter or hiring manager approves rejection. Assess the intended use under the EU AI Act before deployment.
data_needed: Approved, job-relevant vacancy requirements
Candidate applications and submitted certificates
Explicit availability information
Access permissions and candidate-data retention rules
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted recruitment audit log containing source references, checklist version, corrections and the approving person.

evidence.claim: Language models can extract explicit facts from CVs into a structured checklist, but extraction accuracy requires local testing.
Recruitee supports candidate pipelines and team evaluation workflows.
A 40% task-time reduction is a planning hypothesis for Noordhaven, not an observed result.

risks: Extraction errors could hide relevant experience or misstate certificate validity.
Recruitment AI may fall within the EU AI Act's high-risk rules; avoiding ranking does not automatically remove that classification.
AVG/GDPR obligations include data minimization, transparent processing and protection against unlawful solely automated decisions.
Biased vacancy criteria can persist even when extraction is accurate; involve the OR where its statutory rights apply.
research_questions: On a representative sample of Dutch and other-language applications, how often are important facts missed or invented?
Are vacancy requirements explicit, necessary and consistently applied across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo?
What EU AI Act classification, GDPR assessment and OR process does this intended use require?
Does reviewed extraction reduce handling time without worsening referral quality or day-90 outcomes?

tasks.short: Send applicants their approved acceptance or rejection and record the communication in Recruitee.

today.trigger: The recruiter or hiring manager records an acceptance or rejection decision.
steps: Confirm the approved decision and whether an offer is ready to send.
Select the appropriate message and check candidate, vacancy and site details.
Send the message or arrange a personal call.
Record the communication and any follow-up in Recruitee.
drudgery: Inserting names, roles, dates and contact details.
Sending similar messages one by one.
Checking whether the pipeline status matches the communication.
today.time_sinks: Template handling and duplicate status updates; waiting for a hiring decision is outside the proposed automation.

lenses.faster: Populate approved templates from Recruitee and send them from one workflow. Manual copying and separate communication logging disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An explicitly approved decision triggers a standard message. Exceptions, personal feedback and offers with incomplete approvals stop in a review queue.
lenses.ambitious: Give every applicant a timely answer, including seasonal applicants. Track unanswered replies and whether communication delays reduce offer acceptance.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive sending and status maintenance. Keep personal calls and constructive feedback where they matter.
lenses.options: Maintain approved variants for early rejection, post-interview rejection and accepted offers, with language and site variants.
lenses.altitude: The administrator owns communication standards, exception handling and response-time checks.
reach: Manage recruitment communication service levels.
Prepare offer handover details for onboarding.
Maintain recruiter-approved candidate message templates.

tasks.human_edge: People own the hiring decision, contractual commitments and sensitive feedback after interviews.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: once the decision and wording are approved, merging fields, sending and logging follow explicit rules without a model.

in_practice.trigger: An authorized person records a final decision and marks the communication ready in Recruitee.
steps: Validate the decision, recipient and required template fields.
Confirm offer approvals and attach only the approved offer document when applicable.
Send the approved message unless the case requires a personal call or bespoke feedback.
Record delivery and prevent duplicate sends if the workflow retries.
Route failed deliveries, replies and exceptional cases to the administrator.
in_practice.human_gate: The hiring decision is approved upstream. Offer terms require authorized approval; bespoke feedback and designated sensitive cases require message review.
data_needed: Authorized final hiring decision
Candidate contact details and vacancy identifiers
Approved message templates
Approved offer documents and start dates
in_practice.logs_to: Recruitee communication history and a restricted workflow log recording decision approval, template version and delivery status.

evidence.claim: Recruitee provides email templates and automated actions associated with recruitment workflows.
Field validation and duplicate-send prevention can be implemented using deterministic workflow rules.
A 65% task-time reduction is a planning estimate, assuming a large share of standard messages.

risks: An incorrect pipeline change could send a premature rejection or acceptance.
Unapproved offer wording could create an unintended employment commitment.
Template errors or wrong attachments could disclose another candidate's information.
Personal feedback may be necessary after interviews even when standard communication is technically possible.
research_questions: Which Recruitee events distinguish an approved decision from a provisional pipeline change?
What proportion of messages use standard wording versus personal calls or bespoke feedback?
Do the available Recruitee features support approval checks, delivery logging and safe retries?
Can a pilot reduce handling time while maintaining offer acceptance and candidate satisfaction?

tasks.short: Help employees with benefits, eligibility questions and the administration of workplace injury and insurance cases.

today.trigger: An employee asks about a benefit, a life event changes eligibility, or a workplace incident requires administrative follow-up.
steps: Identify the request and applicable employment arrangement or CAO.
Check relevant AFAS records and approved benefit or insurance rules.
Collect necessary administrative information and explain the next steps.
Prepare changes or case documents for the responsible specialist.
Track completion and inform the employee.
drudgery: Finding the correct CAO and policy version.
Repeatedly explaining routine eligibility and document requirements.
Chasing incomplete forms and copying approved information.
today.time_sinks: Policy lookup, incomplete requests and handoffs. Dutch workplace cases involve sick-pay, liability or insurance administration rather than assuming a US workers' compensation scheme.

lenses.faster: Use a guided request form and retrieve the applicable approved policy with citations. Prepare complete case packs and draft answers before the administrator reviews them.
lenses.autonomous: Standard requests trigger completeness checks, reminders and draft AFAS changes. Eligibility exceptions, financial consequences and injury cases require review.
lenses.ambitious: Check routine benefits administration for missed entitlements and unresolved cases across all three sites. Offer clear guidance that shift workers can access outside office hours.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated policy searches and form chasing. Keep helping employees understand choices and resolving difficult cases.
lenses.options: Show permitted benefit choices and their documented eligibility rules. Route unusual situations to the specialist rather than inventing an answer.
lenses.altitude: The administrator maintains request journeys, policy sources and controls for correct handoffs.
reach: Prepare benefits cases for the Compensation and Benefits Specialist.
Prepare approved payroll-change inputs for the Payroll Specialist.
Coordinate administrative workplace-incident follow-up with the responsible HRBP.

tasks.human_edge: Employees need a trusted person for financial concerns, disputed eligibility and distressing workplace incidents.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: deterministic rules check completeness and eligibility where possible; an llm_step drafts policy-based explanations, with approval before substantive advice or changes.

in_practice.trigger: A benefits request or administrative incident case enters the restricted HR request workflow.
steps: Classify the request and confirm the employee's applicable CAO and benefit arrangement.
Retrieve approved rules and only the employee fields needed for the request.
Check completeness and prepare a cited explanation or proposed administrative change.
Route eligibility disputes, payroll effects and incident cases to the designated specialist.
Apply approved changes through the authorized workflow and track completion.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator approves substantive replies; the designated specialist approves benefit decisions, payroll effects and insurance or liability submissions.
data_needed: Versioned CAO and benefit rules
Relevant contract and employment fields
Approved forms and specialist routing rules
Necessary administrative incident facts, excluding diagnoses and treatment details
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted AFAS case or HR case register recording policy versions, proposed changes, approvals and completion.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit and InSite support HR workflows and employee self-service.
Policy retrieval can support cited draft answers, but correct CAO interpretation and exceptions need local validation.
A 35% task-time reduction is an untested estimate for the proposed mix of routine and exceptional cases.

risks: The transport CAO, warehouse CAO and agency-worker arrangements may produce different answers.
Outdated policies could lead to incorrect entitlements or payroll changes.
Medical details must stay with authorized occupational-health professionals; HR automation should use necessary administrative information only.
Wet verbetering poortwachter duties and liability decisions cannot be replaced by an administrative assistant's generated advice.
research_questions: Which recurring requests have explicit rules and which require specialist interpretation?
Are current CAO, benefits and insurance rules versioned and linked to the correct employee groups?
Can AFAS provide restricted access and approval-controlled updates without exposing medical information?
Does a pilot reduce handling time, repeat questions and incomplete cases without increasing corrections?

tasks.short: Publish approved vacancies and tell relevant employees about internal opportunities.

today.trigger: A hiring manager and recruiter approve a vacancy for internal or external publication.
steps: Collect approved role, site, shift, pay and application details.
Prepare the vacancy text using the company template.
Check the wording and employment details with the recruiter.
Publish through Recruitee and approved internal channels.
Check publication and correct outdated or inconsistent listings.
drudgery: Reformatting the same vacancy for several channels.
Copying site, shift and contact details.
Checking closing dates and removing stale postings.
today.time_sinks: Incomplete vacancy briefs, repeated formatting and channel checks; approval delays remain unless vacancy ownership improves.

lenses.faster: Generate channel-specific drafts from one structured vacancy brief. Publish approved versions and synchronize closing dates through a controlled workflow.
lenses.autonomous: Vacancy approval triggers publishing and scheduled closure. Missing pay, shift or site details block publication and create an exception.
lenses.ambitious: Make every internal opportunity visible to shift workers at all three sites. Test whether clearer shift and pay information improves suitable applications and offer acceptance.
lenses.joy: Remove copying, formatting and stale-post checks. Keep improving how Noordhaven explains the job to applicants.
lenses.options: Prepare variants emphasizing schedule, training or progression, using the same approved facts. Compare channel choices within the recruiter's budget and recruitment plan.
lenses.altitude: The administrator manages the vacancy brief, publishing rules and accuracy across channels.
reach: Support recruiters with recruitment copy and channel administration.
Coordinate internal mobility announcements with HRBPs.
Maintain hiring-manager vacancy briefing templates.

tasks.human_edge: The recruiter and manager decide how to represent the role honestly and which requirements and employment terms are appropriate.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: an llm_step adapts approved facts into channel drafts; deterministic publishing follows human approval of the wording and employment terms.

in_practice.trigger: An approved vacancy brief is marked ready for drafting in Recruitee.
steps: Validate required role, CAO, pay, site, shift and closing-date fields.
Draft internal and external versions using approved templates and facts.
Have the recruiter approve wording and the responsible owner verify employment terms.
Publish approved versions through configured Recruitee and internal channels.
Verify publication and close or update listings when the vacancy status changes.
in_practice.human_gate: The recruiter approves each vacancy's wording and channels; the authorized HR owner verifies CAO and employment terms before publication.
data_needed: Approved structured vacancy brief
Current CAO and pay information
Approved channel templates and publication permissions
Internal communication routes accessible to shift workers
in_practice.logs_to: Recruitee vacancy history with approved copy, approving person, channel links, publication checks and closure status.

evidence.claim: Recruitee supports vacancy publication through career sites and job-board integrations.
Language models can prepare channel-specific text from an approved brief, subject to factual review.
A 55% task-time reduction depends on complete briefs and functioning channel integrations.

risks: Generated copy could invent benefits, pay, shift arrangements or certificate requirements.
Internal announcements may miss warehouse and transport workers without regular Microsoft 365 access.
Targeting internal opportunities using inferred age, health or other protected characteristics could discriminate.
Unsynchronized listings could continue attracting applicants after a vacancy closes.
research_questions: How often do vacancy briefs arrive complete enough to publish without follow-up?
Which channels can Recruitee publish to and close reliably under Noordhaven's subscription?
Which internal channels actually reach employees on every shift?
Do approved text variants improve suitable applications without misleading applicants or changing employment terms?

tasks.short: Find approved employee information and prepare employment statements for authorized requesters.

today.trigger: An employee, authorized internal colleague or verified external organization requests specific employment information.
steps: Verify the requester, purpose and authority to receive the information.
Find the relevant employment records in AFAS or restricted SharePoint files.
Select the necessary fields and prepare a statement or response.
Check the recipient and release the approved information.
Record what was disclosed and to whom.
drudgery: Searching for current contract details.
Copying standard fields into employment statements.
Repeatedly checking request completeness and recipient details.
today.time_sinks: Identity and authority checks, document searches and manual statement preparation; an external request alone does not authorize disclosure.

lenses.faster: Generate standard employment statements from verified AFAS fields. Replace broad file searches with a field-specific retrieval workflow.
lenses.autonomous: Authenticated requests for approved statement types trigger validation and document preparation. External releases and unusual requests enter a review queue.
lenses.ambitious: Give employees faster access to accurate employment documents, including outside office hours. Make disclosures consistently minimal and traceable.
lenses.joy: Remove file hunting and retyping. Keep helping employees resolve urgent requests and unclear records.
lenses.options: Offer approved statement types for employment confirmation or mortgage-related requests. Each type includes only the fields needed for its purpose.
lenses.altitude: The administrator maintains statement definitions, access rules and disclosure quality.
reach: Own routine employee document self-service.
Support the HRIS Analyst with permission and data-quality checks.
Prepare disclosure audit evidence for the responsible privacy officer.

tasks.human_edge: A person resolves unclear authority, conflicting records and requests that could materially affect an employee.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: verified fields populate approved templates under explicit access rules; a general-purpose model is unnecessary for standard statements.

in_practice.trigger: An authenticated employee or authorized requester submits a defined statement request.
steps: Verify identity, purpose, access rights and the applicable basis for processing or disclosure.
Retrieve only the approved fields from AFAS and flag conflicting or missing records.
Populate the current statement template and prepare it for any required signature.
Release standard employee self-service documents under approved rules; route external disclosures for review.
Record the release, recipient, purpose and document version.
in_practice.human_gate: An administrator approves external disclosures and unusual requests; any employer declaration or signature follows Noordhaven's signing authority.
data_needed: Verified requester identity and authorization
Approved statement-specific AFAS fields
Current templates and signing rules
Disclosure purposes, retention rules and permitted recipients
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted disclosure register recording request, fields released, recipient, approval and delivery; avoid duplicating full personnel records in logs.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports HR records, employee self-service and document workflows.
Standard statements can be generated from approved structured fields without a language model.
A 60% task-time reduction assumes most requests fit approved statement types.

risks: Mistaken identity or recipient selection could disclose personal employment or salary information.
Employer statements may require judgments or declarations beyond directly copying AFAS fields.
Broad search access could expose absence or other sensitive information unnecessary for the request.
An employee request or authorization must be assessed appropriately; consent is not a universal solution for employment-data processing.
research_questions: What share of requests can be served by a small set of approved statement templates?
Which statement fields require interpretation, guarantees or an authorized signature?
Can AFAS and delivery controls enforce field-level access and verified recipients?
Does a pilot reduce handling time while producing complete, accurate disclosure records?

tasks.short: Prepare personnel reports and supporting documents from the agreed HR data sources.

today.trigger: A recurring reporting date or an authorized request from HR, a manager or the OR.
steps: Confirm the report's purpose, period, audience and definitions.
Collect AFAS, Recruitee or Studytube data and any required agency figures.
Reconcile identifiers, dates and totals in Excel or Power BI.
Prepare tables, charts and supporting notes.
Check accuracy and permissions before distribution.
drudgery: Downloading recurring extracts.
Reconciling employee and agency identifiers.
Rebuilding tables and repeating the same formatting.
today.time_sinks: Reconciliation, inconsistent metric definitions and checking freshness; the existing AFAS dashboard extract refreshes nightly.

lenses.faster: Create reusable queries, reconciliations and report templates. Recurring exports, spreadsheet joins and formatting largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A successful data refresh triggers validated report preparation. Missing sources, failed checks or unusual movements hold the report for review.
lenses.ambitious: Produce a consistent vacancy-to-day-90 view by site and role, once productivity and retention definitions are agreed. Connect week-one onboarding and certificate completion to later outcomes.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet assembly and repeated formatting. Keep investigating anomalies and explaining what managers can act on.
lenses.options: Offer approved views by site, role, cohort and employment type. Show alternative definitions explicitly where stakeholders have not yet agreed one.
lenses.altitude: The administrator owns report reliability, definitions and exception checks with the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
reach: Maintain recurring HR operational reporting.
Prepare reconciled workforce inputs for Finance and FP&A.
Prepare approved aggregate reporting packs for the OR.

tasks.human_edge: People decide what a metric means, whether a comparison is fair and how managers should respond to it.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: extraction, joins, calculations and standard report assembly are checkable rules; optional narrative drafting should use validated aggregates only.

in_practice.trigger: The scheduled reporting cycle starts after the required source refreshes succeed.
steps: Load approved extracts and record each source's refresh time.
Join records using controlled identifiers and apply versioned metric definitions.
Run reconciliation, completeness, cohort-maturity and privacy checks.
Generate the approved report and flag anomalies with supporting figures.
Publish routine reports under agreed rules and route exceptions or new interpretations for review.
in_practice.human_gate: The HRIS Analyst approves definitions and data joins; the administrator reviews exceptions, new reports and narrative interpretations before release.
data_needed: Versioned definitions for hiring, onboarding, absence and retention metrics
Controlled identifiers and dated employment records
Recruitee and Studytube events
Agency workforce figures with clear scope
An agreed productivity measure and day-90 cohort rules
Audience permissions and small-group disclosure rules
in_practice.logs_to: Reporting audit register with source timestamps, definition versions, reconciliation results, exceptions and publication history.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports scheduled data refresh, reusable data models and access controls.
Deterministic reconciliation and report-generation rules can replace repeated spreadsheet assembly when definitions and identifiers are stable.
A 70% task-time reduction is a hypothesis for recurring reports after setup, not a measured Noordhaven result.

risks: Nightly AFAS data may be mistaken for current operational data.
Employee, candidate and agency identifiers may not join reliably.
Incomplete 90-day cohorts or an undefined productivity measure could distort the North Star.
Small-group absence or retention reports could identify individuals; avoid medical details and unapproved individual profiling.
research_questions: Which recurring reports account for most preparation time and how much of their logic is stable?
Can source totals reconcile across AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and agency data?
How will Noordhaven measure productivity at day 90, including transfers and seasonal hires?
Do automated reports pass accuracy, freshness and access checks while reducing total preparation and correction time?

tasks.short: Keep organization charts, employee directories, handbooks and HR forms current.

today.trigger: An organizational change, employee change, approved policy revision or scheduled document review.
steps: Identify the affected documents and their owners.
Check AFAS records and approved policy or organizational changes.
Update charts, directories, handbook sections or form templates.
Obtain the relevant owner's approval and complete any required OR process.
Publish the current version and archive or redirect superseded copies.
drudgery: Updating names and reporting lines in several places.
Finding duplicate or outdated documents.
Reformatting approved text and chasing review dates.
today.time_sinks: Duplicate documents, unclear ownership and manual synchronization; substantive policy approvals remain necessary.

lenses.faster: Generate directories and organization charts from approved AFAS fields. Prepare policy-document changes as visible edits against the current approved version.
lenses.autonomous: Approved personnel changes update permitted directory fields, while review dates and policy approvals trigger document workflows. Substantive wording changes wait for owner approval.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain one reliable HR document library with clear ownership, review dates and accessible versions for all sites. Detect conflicting CAO references and obsolete forms before employees use them.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated name changes, formatting and version hunting. Keep improving guidance so employees can understand and use it.
lenses.options: Prepare short employee guidance alongside the formal policy and site-specific instructions where justified. Offer alternative layouts for charts and forms without changing approved meaning.
lenses.altitude: The administrator manages the document lifecycle, source fields and publication standards.
reach: Maintain HR knowledge-library governance.
Support L&D with current onboarding guidance.
Prepare document changes and comparison packs for HR policy owners and the OR.

tasks.human_edge: Policy owners preserve legal meaning, negotiate organizational changes and decide how performance processes should work.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: deterministic software updates structured directories and charts; an llm_step drafts document edits, with approval before policy or form changes are published.

in_practice.trigger: An approved AFAS change, approved policy amendment or document review date starts the workflow.
steps: Identify affected documents using their registered owners, source fields and dependencies.
Regenerate approved directory or chart fields and draft other changes against the current version.
Check dates, links, CAO references, permissions and differences between versions.
Obtain owner approval and complete applicable OR consultation or consent before substantive publication.
Publish the approved version, archive superseded copies and notify the intended audience.
in_practice.human_gate: Policy owners approve substantive wording and form changes; applicable OR rights are completed before adoption. Approved routine directory changes can publish under standing rules.
data_needed: Approved organizational and directory fields
Current policy documents and CAO sources
Document ownership, version and review-date register
Approved change instructions
Publication permissions and OR process status
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint version history and approval register containing change sources, visible differences, approvals and publication dates.

evidence.claim: SharePoint supports document version history and content approval.
Structured employee fields can drive directory and organization-chart generation, while language models can draft reviewable document edits.
A 55% task-time reduction depends on reliable source data and removing duplicate document maintenance.

risks: Generated wording could alter a contractual entitlement or the meaning of a CAO provision.
Changes to personnel policies or appraisal arrangements may engage statutory OR rights.
Directory or organization-chart publication could expose fields to an overly broad audience.
Unreliable reporting lines or duplicate files could propagate incorrect information across sites.
research_questions: Which documents can be generated from authoritative fields and which need substantive editorial judgment?
Are document owners, current versions and review dates recorded consistently?
Can the workflow enforce approval and applicable OR requirements before publication?
Does a pilot reduce maintenance time and obsolete-document use without increasing policy corrections?

role.altitude: The HR Administrator becomes the owner of reliable HR service workflows: clear inputs, current records, approved communications, controlled publication and fast exception handling.
reach: Recruitment operations: application briefings, approved communications and vacancy publishing.
Benefits operations: complete case preparation and approved payroll-change handoffs.
People Analytics support: recurring reports, reconciliations and metric-quality checks.
L&D support: current onboarding documents and administrative certificate-status reporting.
HRIS support: document workflows, permissions checks and employee self-service maintenance.
role.ceiling_note: These seven tasks represent about 26.5% of the role's supplied time allocation. The task estimates imply roughly 450 hours of annual capacity across 2 FTE, about 14% of their combined 3,200-hour baseline and EUR 21,600 at EUR 48/hour. These are untested steady-state estimates, exclude implementation and ongoing governance effort, and represent capacity rather than automatic cash savings. Hiring decisions, policy interpretation, sensitive conversations, signatures and specialist approvals limit further autonomy.
skills_to_grow: Map processes and distinguish written rules from judgment.
Configure AFAS, Recruitee and Microsoft 365 workflows with the HRIS Analyst.
Validate data, reconcile reports and maintain metric definitions.
Check model extractions and drafts against cited sources.
Apply AVG/GDPR access, disclosure and retention rules.
Recognize CAO differences, OR rights and employment-related EU AI Act obligations.
Design employee services that work for shift workers at all three sites.
Measure handling time, correction rates and service outcomes before scaling automation.
role.ambitious_version: Run an accessible HR service operation across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo that keeps applications moving, communications timely, employee documents accurate and onboarding handoffs complete. Use the released capacity to identify administrative causes of missed week-one onboarding and day-90 losses, then improve those workflows with recruiters, HRBPs, L&D and People Analytics.
